rule: PLANTED-PROBE ADMISSIBILITY, registered 2026-08-09 BEFORE the replacement auditor's routing was read
trigger: aops_curation_r1 blind routing auditor #1 scored 3/4 on the planted probe battery: P03 'Argues the step a competent reader would stop at' (expected quality_relevant) was routed incidental. P01/P02/P04 passed.
why_a_rule_is_needed: The freeze plants probes precisely to certify that an auditor can tell the tracks apart, but it does not name the remedy when one fails. Both math.SE campaigns recorded 4/4 every round, so no precedent existed. Fixing the remedy now, before the replacement's verdicts exist, is what keeps this from being a cherry-pick.
precedent_used: the same cell's own Layer-1 Gemma anchor battery, which marks a shard invalid and REDRAWS when the pos/neg anchor ordering fails (aops_curation_ledger.json anchor_reports: shards 4 and 5 each retried once). An auditor is a judge; a judge that fails its blinded known-label anchors is not admitted.
decision_rule: 1. Auditor #1 is NOT ADMITTED as the routing of record. Its verdicts and the routing they produced are retained verbatim as *_AUDITOR1_FAILED_PROBE.json and reported, never deleted.
2. A FRESH auditor instance is drawn on the identical prompt (same 29 items, same 4 planted probes, same blinding).
3. If auditor #2 passes 4/4, its routing is the routing of record for round 1 and the disagreement between the two auditors is reported as an instrument-noise measurement.

4. If auditor #2 also fails a probe, NEITHER is admitted as clean; the round is recorded with a degraded-audit flag, both routings are reported, and the frontier arbiter adjudicates every item on which the two auditors disagree, not merely the audit-vs-proposer disputes.
5. No third draw. Two failures is a finding about the item set, not an auditor to be resampled until it agrees.
what_this_rule_may_NOT_do: It may not be applied selectively after seeing whether the replacement's routing is more favourable to Track A or Track B. The admissibility test is the probe battery alone, which is label-blind and fixed before either auditor ran.
